ufaq.post_title: How do I create an account?
ufaq.post_content: To create an account, click the 'Sign Up' button in the top right corner. Fill in your email address and choose a password. You'll receive a confirmation email to verify your account.

ufaq.post_title: What payment methods do you accept?
ufaq.post_content: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers for orders over $500.

ufaq.post_title: How do I reset my password?
ufaq.post_content: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password. The link expires after 24 hours.
